mutant_records.description: Substitute composite modulus n=6 into Fermat's Little Theorem (2^5 = 32 = 2 != 1 mod 6).
Use non-coprime moduli m1=4, m2=6 with contradictory residues x=1 mod 4 and x=2 mod 6.
Perturb Bézout multiplier pair (x, y) such that a*x + b*y != gcd(a, b).
Evaluate power a^{phi(n)+1} mod n violating group order identity.
Attempt to form factor group on non-normal subgroup H = <(1 2)> in S_3 (coset multiplication ill-defined).
Perturb a single entry in Cayley multiplication table to violate associativity (ab)c != a(bc).
Inject map f: G -> H violating homomorphism property f(xy) != f(x)f(y).
Construct unequal coset fiber sizes violating equipotence |gH| != |H|.
Claim proper non-maximal ideal (0) in finite ring R = Z/4Z yields a quotient field (proper intermediate ideal (2) with (0) subset (2) subset R, so R/(0) ~= Z/4Z is not a field).
Claim composite ideal (6) in Z yields an integral domain (2 * 3 = 0 in Z/6Z).
Attempt to construct field extension via reducible polynomial x^2 - 1 = (x-1)(x+1) in F_2[x].
Perturb Frobenius map x |-> x^p violating fresh-man's dream (x+y)^p != x^p + y^p.

relationship_records.mathematical_claim: The division sequence of the Euclidean algorithm constructs the Bézout integer linear multipliers (x, y) via backward substitution matrix recursion.
relationship_records.notes: Euclidean descent constructed valid Bézout certificate.

relationship_records.mathematical_claim: The least positive integer linear combination d = ax + by satisfies d | a, d | b, and for all c > 0 (c | a and c | b implies c | d and c <= d), establishing d = gcd(a, b).
relationship_records.notes: Bézout least positive linear combination proves d = gcd(a,b) with d|a, d|b, and universal positive divisor property.

relationship_witness.universal_divisor_property: forall c > 0: (c|a and c|b) => (c|d and c <= d)

relationship_records.mathematical_claim: Euler's theorem a^{phi(n)} == 1 (mod n) specializes to Fermat's Little Theorem a^{p-1} == 1 (mod p) whenever n = p is a prime, since phi(p) = p - 1.
relationship_records.notes: Euler totient specialized to Fermat's Little Theorem under prime modulus.

relationship_records.mathematical_claim: The Chinese Remainder Theorem establishes a bijective ring isomorphism psi: Z/(m_1...m_k)Z -> Z/m_1 Z x ... x Z/m_k Z with trivial kernel and reconstructed inverse for pairwise coprime moduli gcd(m_i, m_j) = 1.
relationship_records.notes: CRT ring isomorphism verified via forward homomorphism, kernel triviality, and reconstructed inverse.

relationship_records.mathematical_claim: The left cosets of subgroup H in G partition the finite group G into [G:H] disjoint fibers of uniform size |H|, establishing Lagrange's formula |G| = [G:H] * |H|.
relationship_records.notes: Equipotent coset partition establishes Lagrange index formula.

relationship_records.mathematical_claim: Any group homomorphism f: G -> H constructs a unique kernel subgroup ker f = f^{-1}(e_H) and image subgroup im f <= H.
relationship_records.notes: Homomorphism map constructs kernel subgroup and image subgroup.

relationship_records.mathematical_claim: The kernel of any group homomorphism f: G -> H is invariant under conjugation (g (ker f) g^{-1} = ker f for all g in G), and hence is normal in G.
relationship_records.notes: Kernel of homomorphism is invariant under conjugation.

relationship_records.mathematical_claim: A normal subgroup N <| G constructs a well-defined factor group G/N with coset operation (aN)(bN) = (ab)N.
relationship_records.notes: Normal subgroup constructs well-defined factor group.

relationship_records.mathematical_claim: The factor group G/ker f is canonically isomorphic to the image subgroup im f under the bijective group homomorphism g(ker f) |-> f(g).
relationship_records.notes: Factor group G/ker f is canonically isomorphic to im f via bijective group homomorphism.

relationship_records.mathematical_claim: The Orbit-Stabilizer theorem decomposes the group action fibers G/Stab(x) ~= Orb(x), deriving |G| = |Orb(x)| * |Stab(x)| as a direct consequence of Lagrange's theorem on Stab(x) <= G.
relationship_records.notes: Orbit-Stabilizer decomposes action into stabilizer coset fibers.

relationship_records.mathematical_claim: An ideal P in a commutative ring R with unity is prime if and only if the quotient ring R/P is an integral domain.
relationship_records.notes: Prime ideal yields zero-divisor-free integral domain quotient.

relationship_records.mathematical_claim: An ideal M in a finite commutative ring R with unity (or where |R/M| < inf) is maximal if and only if the quotient ring R/M is a finite field GF(q).
relationship_records.notes: Maximal ideal in finite commutative ring constructs finite quotient field with unit invertibility.

relationship_records.mathematical_claim: An irreducible polynomial p(x) in F[x] constructs a simple algebraic field extension K = F[x]/(p(x)) with degree [K:F] = deg(p).
relationship_records.notes: Irreducible polynomial constructs simple field extension.

relationship_records.mathematical_claim: The multiplicative group of any finite field GF(q)^x is cyclic of order q - 1, isomorphic to (Z/(q-1)Z, +).
relationship_records.notes: Finite field multiplicative group is cyclic.
